risks.title: Cyberattacks and unauthorized access to information systems
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned at the beginning of the risk factors with strong language (unauthorized access). Dedicated governance confirmed (CIO with over 30 years of experience, CISO with over 25 years including 10+ in cybersecurity leadership). Sophisticated assessment protocols (internal assessments, third-party audits, testing against standards). Highly critical sector (sensitive research data, patient data).

risks.title: Litigation related to non-human primates
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 3 with multiple ongoing actions (class actions, derivative actions). Appeal partially upheld on August 15, 2025, confirming risk exposure. Firm language on defense but significant financial and reputational exposure.

risks.title: Fiduciary duties of executives and regulatory compliance
risks.score_rationale: Litigation against executives alleging breaches of fiduciary duties and compliance obligations. Repeated references across multiple paragraphs in the 10-K with allusions to the Code of Conduct. Potential impact on governance and internal control practices.

risks.title: Residual lease obligations following divestitures
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 2 regarding residual obligations after acquisitions or divestitures. Moderate language (may be encumbered) but potential impact on fixed operational costs post-CDMO/Cell Solutions divestiture.

risks.title: Geographic concentration of real estate assets
risks.score_rationale: Significant real estate portfolio held in the United States, China, and Europe with approximately 65% concentration exposure. Implicit risk of geopolitical disruptions or local regulatory changes affecting critical sites.

ai_positioning.summary: Charles River Laboratories does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning as strategic or operational elements in its 10-K filing for the 2025 fiscal year.
